items.body: Pittsburgh post-punk and shoegaze duo Lowsunday have released a music video for “Someone To Talk To“, the third track on their EP “low sunday ghost machine black ep”. The video went up on August 25, 2026 and was directed by Jer Herring, who has worked on the band’s earlier clips. The EP itself came out on Projekt Records on May 15, 2026. Bobby Spell connects the visuals to a subject the duo return to across the release: “This video conveys the delicate coldness, detachment and loneliness of this song. A theme frequently visited by us involves a feeling of isolation which seems to be increasingly common in modern life. The visuals in the video demonstrate this feeling in a variety of scenarios where separation, miscommunication or distance is implied throughout. Our creative partner Jer Herring has once again created a perfect visual counterpart for a Lowsunday song and we’re very proud of it.” The ‘Black EP’ and its five tracks “low sunday ghost machine black ep” holds five songs: “You’re So Wired”, “Shattered”, “Someone To Talk To”, “This Is Not Heaven” and “Don’t Want To Dream Again”. Projekt Records issued it on May 15, 2026 as a digital release and as a one-sided 12-inch vinyl EP limited to 200 copies. It is the second half of a two-part series that began with “low sunday ghost machine white ep” in November 2025. Videos have now been released for three of the five tracks. Side-Line covered the You’re So Wired clip in July. low sunday ghost machine black ep by lowsunday About Lowsunday Lowsunday formed in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania in 1994 under the name Low Sunday Ghost Machine. The group self-released a debut album under that name in 1996, with Shane Sahene on vocals and guitar, Scott Bedillion on guitar, Marc Turina on bass and Dale Reckless on synthesizer, produced by Lou Contumelio. A second record, “Elesgiem”, circulated as a self-released promo CD in 1999 before Projekt Records issued it commercially on April 3, 2001. Sahene produced it and played guitar and sang, Bobby Spell played bass and engineered, and A. T. Vish, Shaun Leslie and Shawn Bann filled out the sessions; Peter Beckerman mixed. Projekt released a remaster of “Elesgiem” in 2024 and a sixteen-track remaster of the 1996 debut in 2025, the latter including a 1999 re-recording of “For A Moment”. The band returned to new material with “low sunday ghost machine white ep” on November 28, 2025, its first all-new songs since 1999. Side-Line covered the “Soft Capture” and “Nevver” videos from that EP. Lowsunday is now a duo of Shane Sahene, who handles vocals, guitar, synth, bass and drums, and Bobby Spell on bass, guitar and drums. “Someone To Talk To” is the third video pulled from the “Black EP”, which closes out the two-part series the band began in late 2025.
items._cn_summary: Lowsunday是一支来自匹兹堡的后朋克与自赏派二人组，2026年发布了MV"Someone To Talk To"，该曲来自与Projekt Records合作的EP"low sunday ghost machine black ep"。整张EP共五首歌，延续了乐队对疏离、孤独与隔阂等主题的探讨，MV通过多场景视觉呈现分离与误读。乐队前身Low Sunday Ghost Machine成立于1994年，曾活跃于上世纪末，2001年由Projekt Records发行专辑"Elesgiem"，2024与2025年分别推出该专辑与首张专辑的重制版。2025年底的"white ep"是乐队自1999年以来首次发表全新原创作品，本次"black ep"延续了两部曲的下半部分。音乐以吉他、人声与合成器为核心架构，成员Shane Sahene与Bobby Spell身兼多职，在创作上保留了深沉冷峻的氛围。整体定位属于独立暗潮/后朋克谱系，适合偏好低沉情绪与冷感音色的听众。

items.body: Dublin post-punk band Fontaines D.C. release their fifth studio album, “Dopamine Chamber”, on 16 October 2026 through XL Recordings. The band confirmed the album on 18 August 2026 and issued the lead single “Marianne” the same day, with an official video directed by Dave Meyers and Cam Erickson. The album runs to eleven tracks. Only two titles are public so far: “Marianne”, which sits second, and the opener “Six Shot Morning”, which the band played live in Cádiz before the announcement. The full tracklist has not been published, and the band’s own release page still lists it as coming. James Ford produced ‘Dopamine Chamber’ in London and Palermo James Ford produced the record, as he did on “Romance” in 2024. Sessions moved between London, the English countryside and Palermo, where Grian Chatten recorded vocals in a makeshift booth built from mattresses and cushions. The label describes the result as a move away from guitars toward cold synthesiser tones, marching drums, samples and triggers, with several songs carrying no guitar at all. Chatten describes the album as a device rather than a set of songs: “The album itself is a dopamine chamber. You step inside and we test these different mind- or mood-altering pieces of music on you.” He measures the shift against the previous record in the same terms the band used for it. “I think “Romance” was maybe 60 per cent human and 40 per cent corrupted by automation, and a loss of feeling… This one feels more like 60 per cent corrupted – the mask is wearing the face a little more.” On the decision to strip out the consolation the earlier album ended on, he said: “I felt it would be more powerful to leave the hope out and reflect the ugliness honestly. This one needed to feel more like a catastrophic warning.” Bassist Conor Deegan III places the record in a run of albums built around location. “Our albums have always questioned a sense of place. First Dublin, then being away from Dublin, and then trying to find the romance elsewhere. On this record, the question became: where do you escape to?” Guitarist Conor Curley describes his own brief in one line: “I was trying to find stuff that pointed into the future.” “Dopamine Chamber” comes in six physical editions. The deluxe version is a double LP cut at 45rpm on black vinyl in a gatefold jacket with printed innersleeves, a printed insert and a poster. There are single LPs on blue and on black vinyl, both gatefold with a printed innersleeve and insert, a blue marble pressing sold as an indie-store exclusive, a CD in a gatefold digipak, and a cassette with alternate artwork and a foldout J-card. Pre-orders run through the band’s own store, the XL Recordings shop, Bandcamp and independent retailers. Dopamine Chamber by Fontaines D.C. Fontaines D.C. live dates in 2026 The dates listed alongside the announcement are the band’s existing summer and autumn festival commitments rather than an album tour. A separate headline run tied to “Dopamine Chamber” has not been announced. 18 August 2026 – Lausanne, Les Docks, Switzerland 20 August 2026 – Sankt Polten, FM4 Frequency, Austria 28 August 2026 – Reading, Reading Festival, UK 29 August 2026 – Leeds, Leeds Festival, UK 30 August 2026 – Stradbally, Electric Picnic, Ireland 18 September 2026 – Atlanta, GA, Shaky Knees, USA 20 September 2026 – Asbury Park, NJ, Sea.Hear.Now, USA 27 September 2026 – Dana Point, CA, Ohana Festival, USA About Fontaines D.C. Fontaines D.C. formed in Dublin in 2014, after the five members met at BIMM Dublin. The line-up has been unchanged since: Grian Chatten on vocals, Carlos O’Connell and Conor Curley on guitars, Conor Deegan III on bass and Tom Coll on drums. The band signed to Partisan Records in 2018. The debut album “Dogrel” came out on 12 April 2019, produced by Dan Carey, and was nominated for the Mercury Prize and the Choice Music Prize. Carey also produced “A Hero’s Death”, released on 31 July 2020, which entered the UK chart at No. 2 and brought a Grammy nomination for Best Rock Album and a Brit nomination for International Group. The third album, “Skinty Fia”, followed on 22 April 2022, again with Carey, and gave the band their first No. 1 in both Ireland and the UK; they won the Brit Award for International Group in 2023. “Romance”, released on 23 August 2024, was their first record for XL Recordings and their first with producer James Ford. It entered the UK chart at No. 2, gave the band their first Billboard 200 entry and their first UK singles chart placing with “Starburster”, and won International Group of the Year at the 2025 Brit Awards. A deluxe edition followed in 2025. More recently the band contributed to the Peaky Blinders: Immortal Man soundtrack and to War Child’s charity compilation “HELP(2)”, which was released on 6 March 2026 and carries tracks by both the band and Chatten solo. In August 2026 they played the final live session recorded at the BBC’s Maida Vale studios for 6 Music, their first performance since the death of their manager Trevor Dietz. “Dopamine Chamber” is their second album for XL Recordings and their first release since “Romance”.
items._cn_summary: 都柏林后朋克乐队 Fontaines D.C. 公布第五张录音室专辑《Dopamine Chamber》，由 XL Recordings 于2026年10月发行。James Ford 担任制作，录音辗转伦敦、英国乡村与巴勒莫，Grian Chatten 在用床垫和靠垫搭建的临时隔音间内录制人声。整张专辑刻意偏离吉他驱动的写法，转向冰冷的合成器音色、行军鼓节奏、采样与触发器，多首曲目完全不含吉他。主唱将专辑比作一台多巴胺装置，通过不同心境的音乐片段对听众施加作用，并明确表示去掉了前作中的慰藉感，以呈现更诚实的丑陋与灾难式警示。贝斯手与吉他手分别从空间位移与未来指向两个角度描述创作动机。专辑推出六种实体版本，包括黑胶、CD 与磁带，预售渠道覆盖独立零售。

items.body: Duet Emmo, the one-off collaboration between Daniel Miller of The Normal and Silicon Teens and Wire members Edvard Graham Lewis and B.C. Gilbert, will play live for the first time on Tuesday 27 October 2026 at the ICA in London. The show forms part of the venue’s In The Round series and comes nearly 45 years after the three musicians first met at Blackwing Studio to record “Or So It Seems”, their only album together. Tickets go on sale at 10am UK time on Friday 28 August through DICE, priced at £32.71 including booking fees and the venue levy. The performance takes place on the ICA’s Stage at 7:30pm and uses d&b Soundscape, the venue’s 360-degree spatial soundsystem, with the audience seated around the musicians. The ICA describes the booking in its own announcement: “In association with Mute we’re pleased to announce that Duet Emmo will join ICA’s October In the Round series for a world premiere performance.” Duet Emmo live at the ICA on 27 October Tuesday 27 October 2026 – London, United Kingdom – ICA, The Mall (Stage, 7:30pm) The In The Round programme is curated by the ICA’s Jacob Silkin and runs across the autumn with a separate line-up of electronic and experimental artists. Duet Emmo’s date is presented by the Institute of Contemporary Arts in association with Mute. Or So It Seems (Remastered) by Duet Emmo What ‘Or So It Seems’ is Miller, Lewis and Gilbert recorded the album at Blackwing Studio in London in the gaps between Boxing Day and New Year’s Day in 1981 and 1982, with Eric Radcliffe and John Fryer engineering. All three had other commitments running at the time, and the sessions produced the only record they made together. Mute issued it in August 1983. The project name is an anagram of Mute and Dome, the Lewis and Gilbert duo that ran alongside Wire in the early 1980s. The original sleeve is a collage by the Brothers Quay, the animators and filmmakers, and it was redesigned by Bart van Damme for the reissue. Mute reissued “Or So It Seems” on 19 August 2022, remastered from the original analogue tapes by Stefan Betke at Scape Mastering and expanded to double vinyl, alongside CD and digital editions. Side-Line covered that campaign at the time, first when the reissue was announced and again when the trio shared the remastered “Heart Of Hearts (Or So It Seems)”. The remastered edition runs: “Hill Of Men”, “Or So It Seems”, “Friano”, “The First Person”, “A.N.C”, “Long Sledge”, “Gatemmo”, “Last’s Card” and “Heart Of Hearts (Or So It Seems)”. It is available on Bandcamp and through Mute’s own retail channels. About Duet Emmo Duet Emmo brought together three musicians who already moved through the same London scene. Daniel Miller had released “T.V.O.D.” / “Warm Leatherette” as The Normal in 1978 on the first Mute single, founded the label around it, and followed with the Silicon Teens project. Bruce Gilbert and Graham Lewis were two quarters of Wire, whose first three albums appeared on Harvest between 1977 and 1979, and after the band’s first pause they worked as the duo Dome, releasing four albums under that name between 1980 and 1981 on their own Dome imprint. The three convened at Blackwing Studio in London over the Christmas and New Year periods of 1981 and 1982, with Eric Radcliffe and John Fryer engineering. The resulting album, “Or So It Seems”, appeared on Mute in August 1983, credited to Duet Emmo. A 12-inch of the title track was issued in March 1983, with “Heart Of Hearts” on the B-side; that track later became a bonus cut on CD editions. The record combined electronic sound collage, drone and abstract pop, and it remained the trio’s only release together. Gilbert and Lewis continued as Dome and under further aliases, and both returned to Wire, which reformed in 1985 and again in 2000 and has released studio albums into the 2020s. Miller built Mute into the label behind Depeche Mode, Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds, Erasure and Laibach, and has more recently recorded as Sunroof with Gareth Jones. In 2022 Mute returned to the Duet Emmo album, with Stefan Betke remastering it from the original tapes for a double-vinyl edition released on 19 August that year. The ICA date on 27 October 2026 is the first time the three have taken the project to a stage.
items._cn_summary: Duet Emmo由Mute厂牌创始人Daniel Miller与Wire成员Edvard Graham Lewis和B.C. Gilbert组成，是英国后朋克与工业电子场景的重要交汇。三人1981至1982年间在Blackwing Studio录制了唯一一张专辑《Or So It Seems》，1983年由Mute发行。2022年由Stefan Betke从原始模拟磁带重新母带处理，扩展为双黑胶并附CD与数字版发行。封面由动画师Brothers Quay拼接创作，再版由Bart van Damme重新设计。该项目名称是Mute与Dome的字母变位组合。三位音乐家各自的实验性背景——Miller的合成器朋克源头与Lewis、Gilbert在Wire及Dome中的解构倾向——使得这张唱片在早期工业与后朋克的交汇点上具有独特的历史价值。2026年10月他们将在伦敦ICA进行首次现场演出，采用360度空间声音系统呈现。

items.body: Belgian dark electronic project LLUMEN releases the digital single “The Leftovers” on 4 September 2026 and follows it with the fourth album “Winter Eden” on 30 October 2026, issued on CD and digital by Alfa Matrix. The record runs to twelve tracks and mixes EBM, techno, gothic electronica and future pop, the palette Pieter Coussement has worked with since founding the project in 2001. “The Leftovers” sits third on the album, between “Away From Here” and “Blood And Bone”. The full running order is “Adrift”, “Away From Here”, “The Leftovers”, “Blood And Bone”, “Eden After Winter”, “All Clouds Will Be Horses”, “The Gold Lined Scars”, “Between The Words”, “The Endless Faded Grey”, “I Take What’s Mine”, “Behind The Door” and “Holy Tears”. Coussement describes “Winter Eden” as a record built on contrast, with winter and Eden treated as opposing but linked states, and a sequence that moves from disorientation and detachment toward intimacy and reflection. He describes the album as a record of that distance: “Winter Eden has become a witness to that journey, spanning the distance between who we were and where we stand now.” LLUMEN brings ‘Winter Eden’ to a double release party with Implant One of the twelve tracks has already reached listeners. “Between The Words” appeared in July 2026 on The Odin Files, the darkwave compilation Side-Line issued alongside “The Freya Files” in support of Ukraine. LLUMEN presents the album live on 20 November 2026 at mOtown in Sint-Joost-ten-Node, Belgium, in a double release party with Implant, who launch their own album “The Kinematics of Doubt” at the same event. The two acts previously shared a double release party in Antwerp in October 2021. About LLUMEN LLUMEN is the dark electronic project of Pieter Coussement, based in Ghent, Belgium, and active since 2001. The name draws on Front 242’s “U-Men”, a track Coussement later covered for the Alfa Matrix compilation “Recovery >For You< – An Alfa Matrix Tribute To Front 242” in 2016. The project’s first album, “The Memory Institute”, was issued through Alfa Matrix, with an expanded bonus-tracks edition dated 13 January 2017. “Polygon Heart” followed on 18 June 2021 and the nine-track EP “Die Stille Totgeschwiegen” on 30 November 2023; Side-Line covered the latter in Belgian electro act Llumen is back with 9-track EP ‘Die Stille Totgeschwiegen’ – Out now. Third album “The Breaking Waves” arrived on 17 May 2024 as a limited 2CD set, reported here in Llumen is back with an all new album as a limited 2CD set, and Coussement discussed the record at length in the Llumen interview: ‘The Breaking Waves’ album acts as a reflection of inner turmoil. Alongside its own catalogue, LLUMEN has produced official remixes for Noemi Aurora, C-Lekktor, Pre-Emptive Strike 0.1, Implant, Alien Vampires and Mildreda, and contributed a version of Depeche Mode’s “Halo” to “Alfa Matrix Re:covered Vol.3” in 2019 and a reading of Front 242‘s “Gripped By Fear” to “Recovery 2 For You” in 2026. On stage the project has played Infest, Mechanismus, Castle Party, BIMfest and electriXmas, with its most recent appearance at Infest in Manchester in August 2025. “Winter Eden” is the first LLUMEN full-length since “The Breaking Waves” and the project’s fourth studio album in a run that started twenty-five years ago.
items._genre: dark electronic / EBM / gothic electronica / future pop
items._cn_summary: 比利时暗潮电子项目LLUMEN由Pieter Coussement自2001年延续至今，第四张专辑《Winter Eden》延续EBM、铁克诺、哥特电子与未来流行融合路线。专辑以冬天与伊甸园的对立意象为概念核心，从迷失与疏离逐步走向亲密与反思，十二首曲目以序列结构展开情绪弧线。作品中已有单曲《Between The Words》收录于Side-Line发行的乌克兰支援合辑《The Odin Files》。LLUMEN将与Implant在比利时举办双专场发布会，同台呈现各自新专辑。整体呈现暗潮电子传统的稳健延续，未见显著的实验突破或跨领域融合手法。

items._cn_summary: 本文是对鼓手Lesley Mok个人专辑Profiled的简要介绍，属于转载自Bandcamp Daily的新闻类内容。文章提及Mok以流畅而不可预测的鼓风获得合作机会，曾参与Myra Melford的Fire and Water Quintet及Anna Webber的Shimmer Wince等项目，体现了其在当代即兴爵士圈子中的活跃度。Melford与Webber均属于当代实验爵士/即兴领域的重要声音，说明Mok的音乐语境扎根于自由爵士与先锋即兴传统。但原文为转载性质且篇幅极短，未对专辑的音乐细节、演奏技法、作曲结构或录音特征做任何实质性分析，无法深入判断其在节奏语言、即兴策略或声响探索上的独特性。作为资讯类条目有一定参考价值，作为乐评则信息量严重不足。

items._cn_summary: 这张1971年伦敦Roundhouse现场录音由Daevid Allen和Gilli Smyth领衔的Soft Machine家族成员呈现，融合了口语诗、即兴声乐与自由演奏。Hugh Hopper的贝斯、Robert Wyatt的鼓、Elton Dean的萨克斯与一位匿名小提琴手共同构成了松散而流动的声场。Daevid Allen的人声念白与磁带循环、Gilli Smyth的'太空低语'式即兴演唱交织在爵士、摇滚与迷幻的边界上。曲目以诗歌朗诵和自由即兴为主体，缺乏旋律结构，更多是声音与文字的现场实验。整体具有鲜明的坎特伯雷场景气息，但作为2012年的再版录音，其内容更接近历史档案而非当代创作。

items.body:
Singapore’s electronic music calendar is getting a double dose of heavy hitters, with ARTBAT and Dom Dolla set to make their respective headline debuts in the city at Pasir Panjang Power Station.

Presented by Collective Minds, Ukrainian electronic duo ARTBAT will take over the industrial venue on 17 October, while GRAMMY-nominated Australian DJ and producer Dom Dolla will follow on 27 November.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Collective Minds (@collectivemindsasia)

Formed by Artur Kryvenko and Vitalii “Batish” Limarenko, ARTBAT have built a global following with their melodic techno sound, pairing driving rhythms with cinematic synths and emotionally charged melodies. Their Singapore debut follows appearances at some of electronic music’s biggest stages, including Tomorrowland, Coachella, Ultra Music Festival, EDC, Awakenings, and Time Warp.

The duo made their Ultra Music Festival Miami Mainstage debut earlier this year and returned to Tomorrowland Belgium in July. They are also scheduled to perform on Tomorrowland Thailand’s Mainstage in December.

ARTBAT’s catalogue includes their reimagining of Monolink’s 'Return to Oz', as well as recent releases 'Fight Machine', created with R3HAB, Stylo, Eli & Dani and featuring NAIIM, and 'Take You There' with SIX40TWO. Beyond their own releases, ARTBAT founded UPPERGROUND in 2021, which has since grown from a record label into a large-scale event concept and made its Asian debut in Malaysia this year.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Collective Minds (@collectivemindsasia)

A month later, Dom Dolla will bring his signature house sound to the same venue for his first headline performance in Singapore. The show arrives amid a major global run for the Australian artist, following his sold-out debut stadium performance at Sydney’s Allianz Stadium last December and two sold-out nights at Madison Square Garden. He is also set to perform at Melbourne’s Marvel Stadium in September.

Dom Dolla has also announced headline dates across North America and holds residencies at Hï Ibiza and LIV Las Vegas.

This year, he released Addicted to Bass (Dom Dolla Relapse), an official remix of Puretone’s 'Addicted to Bass', collaborated with Tiga on 'Don’t Worry Baby', and delivered an official remix of KETTAMA’s 'Comes & Goes'. His catalogue has surpassed 1.5 billion streams, while his accolades include a GRAMMY nomination, four ARIA Awards for Best Dance/Electronic Release, and the inaugural ARIA Global Impact Award.

ARTBAT tickets start from S$128++ per person, with General Admission and VIP Stage Pass options available. VIP passes include behind-the-DJ-booth access, fast-track entry, and entry to an exclusive area with a dedicated bar. Dom Dolla tickets will be available via Megatix, with the artist presale opening on 2 September at 10 AM SGT and general sales beginning on 3 September at 10 AM SGT. Click here to for ticketing to both shows.

Like what you read? Show our writer some love!

items._cn_summary: 这是一篇演出新闻报道，而非深度乐评。内容宣布ARTBAT与Dom Dolla将分别于10月17日和11月27日在新加坡Pasir Panjang Power Station举行首次个人演出。ARTBAT被描述为以旋律科技舞曲见长的乌克兰双人组，作品强调节奏律动与电影感合成器，曾登上Tomorrowland、Coachella等大型音乐节，并创立UPPERGROUND厂牌。Dom Dolla则是澳大利亚DJ与制作人，风格偏向主流浩室，拥有格莱美提名、悉尼体育馆与麦迪逊广场花园售罄演出记录，流媒体播放量超过15亿。文章主体为艺人履历与票务信息，缺乏对音乐作品、声音设计或现场体验的具体分析，属于典型的宣传性新闻稿。对于关注实验、前卫或独立电子场景的听众而言，这两位艺人的商业属性较强，创新性与类型融合维度表现平平。

items.body: The Prom on August 20 commemorated the centennial of Miles Davis’s birth. Davis was undoubtedly one of the greatest and most important musicians of the 20th century, but he was not a composer and not just a performer. He was a composing performer, who probably never played the same thing the same way twice. His playing is known to many people, just about everybody now, through his recordings, which were a single example of how he would have done something, and which are also very much a product of his work with arrangers, most especially Gil Evans. It is their collaboration which is known through recordings such as Miles Ahead, Sketches of Spain, and Porgy and Bess. But those recordings can’t just be recreated, nor would anybody want them to be. So the audience for this Prom heard Ambrose Akinmusire, trumpet, Sam Harris, piano, Harish Raghavan, bass, Kendrick Scott, drums, along with the BBC Concert Orchestra, conducted by Miho Hazama, all of them very very fine and wonderful musicians, evoking, through their own playing and different arrangements, which were nonetheless evocations of the famous arrangements, mostly by Gil Evans, the magical quality of Davis’s recordings, and for the most part it all succeeded wonderfully. (For this listener, for instance, the performance of My Ship came far short of the character and quality of Davis’s recording). The program for the concert had a very detailed and informative account of Davis’s life and the development of his career by Alyn Shipton. It also included a short interview with Ambrose Akinmusire about Davis’s influence on succeeding musicians and, in fact, on some of the issues discussed above. It was altogether a very enjoyable evening of music making, celebrating Davis’s creations and achievements.The bulk of the Prom two nights earlier, presented by the BBC Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Cristian Mãelaru, was occupied by the Symphony No. 10 by Shostakovich. That work was preceded, though, by Skyline, a concerto for three percussionists and timpani by Édith Canat de Chizy, which was a BBC co-commission and which was receiving its UK premiere. The soloists were Lucy Landymore, Emma Arden, Delia Stevens, and Richard Cartidge. Skyline over its twenty minute length traces five stages from the emerging of the universe from blackness, through the dawn of the cosmos, the birth of different kinds of starts, the explosion and rhythm of pulsars, to the death of the cosmos. The four soloists were positioned around the orchestra which in fact became a sort of amplifier of their sounds and, in fact, of the argument of the work. The work was continually compelling in its sounds and riveting in its progress. Canat de Chizy was a composers I knew nothing about before this encounter and one who I will look out for going forward. Probably due to the very oppressive cultural climate of the last years of Stalin’s rule in Russia, Shostakovich wrote, or at least, released very few major works during that time. The Tenth Symphony appeared a few months after Stalin’s death, and it was taken, and is probably still taken, as a commentary on that situation. The very abrasive scherzo, the second movement was apparently intended as a portrait of Stalin. This performance presented the work to its fullest advantage. The advertising and presentation of this concert, which mentioned the Shostakovich only and the Canat de Chizy not at all, is an example of how the BBC is currently presenting these concerts in general. In this case, one might have assumed that the Shostakovich was the only piece on the concert, and one would have had to dig deep, or at least deeper, to find that there was another piece on the concert, and that it was by a living composer and had been commissioned by the BBC. The inclusion of newer pieces used to be celebrated; now it’s more or less hidden. The tactic seems pretty clear. One wonders if this particular approach to things really produces a larger audience, which is presumably the goal. In a similar manner, the Prom of the 21st of August, presented by The BBC Philharmonic, conducted by Anja Bihlmaier, with soloists tenor Clay Hiley and mezzo soprano Jamie Barton, only promoted the final work on the concert, Das Lied von der Erde by Mahler, without mentioning the pieces on the first half of the concert, the Haydn Farewell Symphony (No. 45, in f sharp minor) and Mosaic by Bushra El-Turk. El-Turk is a British composer of Lebanese descent whose work has been very much involved with the integration of eastern and western musical elements. Mosaic, lasting 8 minutes, which was receiving its first performance at the Proms, was commissioned by the Manchester Camerata for a season which explored the question of cross-pollination of ideas between cultures. It’s compelling shape is one of increasing activity and intensity from the beginning to a climactic point where the bottom falls out of things and there is a very quiet music which evokes Byzantine chant which concludes the piece after a very brief reminiscence of the previous activity. It was a fine beginning to a concert of equally compelling pieces, all of them masterfully performed. The post BBC Proms Miles Davis, Canat de Chizy, El-Turk, Shostakovich appeared first on Sequenza21.
items._cn_summary: 本文为BBC逍遥音乐节多场演出的乐评合集，涉及三块内容。其一是Miles Davis百年诞辰纪念音乐会，爵士小乐队与BBC音乐会管弦乐团合作，以新编曲重现Davis与Gil Evans合作的经典录音，整体以致敬演绎为主；其二是法国作曲家Édith Canat de Chizy的打击乐协奏曲《Skyline》英国首演，描绘宇宙从诞生到消亡的五阶段，管弦乐团作为打击乐独奏的扩音存在；其三是肖斯塔科维奇第十交响曲。文章为演出现场的描述性乐评，内容被截断，未深入探讨作品创新或声音设计。整体偏向传统管弦乐语境与爵士经典回顾，与实验/前卫/电子等口味交集有限。

items.body: Review by yarstruly — Clicked 5, but really 4.5Simultaneosly posted on my blog: Scott's Song by Song Spotlights, with links to buy and listen.Lonely Robot is a solo project of Irish prog guitarist extraordinaire John Mitchell. John's resume is amazing! John is or has been a member of It Bites, Arena, Frost*, Kino, A, The Urbane, and Asia. His list of guest appearances is far too long to list here, but I know he is on Karmakanic's latest album Transmutation. In addition to being an amazing, in demand guitarist, John is a wonderful singer as well. John has been releasing his solo material as "Lonely Robot" since 2015's "Please Come Home". "The Big Dream" (2017), "Under Stars" (2019), "Feelings are Good" (2020), "A Model Life" (2022) all followed, and I have enjoyed material from every one of them. Now, John is set to release "An Ending" on September 11, 2026. As the title implies, John intends this to be the final Lonely Robot album.Here are the credits:- John Mitchell / vocals, guitars, bass guitar, keyboards- Craig Blundell / drumsWith:- Jez Fielder / guitars (8,9) Craig Blundell is best known for his work with Frost* and Steven Wilson's solo material. Among other things, Jez Fielder is known for his band Indigo Down. Additionally, the album has fantastic artwork from Graeme Purdy Bell. The album comes courtesy of John's PR rep, Sarah Ewing. As always, I receive no further compensation, and I call it like I hear it. As per my usual method, this is a cold listen.Track 1 - This World Window (2:26) The track fades in with synth sounds playing a rhythmic pattern. John's vocals soon join in singing about being a Lonely Robot who's come to say goodbye. There are some wonderful harmonies along the way. It ends with some sound effects and spoken words I can't make out. A bittersweet opener.Track 2 - Show the Way (4:39)A keyboard pattern with a sustained flute-like sound starts us off, then a fast energetic beat kicks in. There are some odd-meters changing things up. I love the vocal melody in the pre-chorus. Nice harmonies in the chorus. The energy in this one is awesome. There is a part where most of the instruments drop out at 2:40 or so. The synth motif is very proggy! John's soaring guitar solo hits at 3:45 and it's wonderful! After another chorus, the song concludes with an a cappella stating of the title. Fantastic track.Track 3 - Back to the Middle (3:51)Keys and a marching snare drum are quickly joined by the full band and John's lead guitar for the intro. The rhythm is a strong mid-tempo groove. The sound is full and rich. I love his voice tone in the opening line "Well, I'm facing hollow promises"... This has a slightly 80s sound to it, lots of reverb and expansive tones. The chorus has a nice hook. His voice reminds me of John Wetton or Greg Lake. A beautiful guitar solo comes in during the middle of the song. The song fades out as it began with the keys and marching snare drum. Wonderful song. Dare I say it?radio friendly?Track 4 - In Ocean Light (5:59)A music box-type tone and sound effects initiate things here. Then it's like a piano ballad with orchestra and mellotron tones. This is a ballad. Subtle drums and bass enter on the second verse. I love the delays when he sings the title line. The intensity is slowly building throughout the song. The guitar solo begins at around 3:45; very melodic. The extended solo develops nicely and becomes more complex and assertive as it goes. There is certainly a David Gilmour influence, but with an occasional fast run. The solo runs all the way until the end of the song. Guitar lovers will really like this one! (And I am a guitar player.)Track 5 - Ad Astra (4:53)The title is Latin for "to the stars". An orchestrated synth part with a spoken-word voice, as if from an interstellar radio transmission, describing the vastness of space, and that some planets are in the "inhabitable zone". A mid-tempo 6-8 beat, driven by Blundell's rimshot drum beat keeps the song moving as Mitchell sings. The choruses build the tension. At around 2:40 there is a brief quiet part before John's guitar playing takes over. Following the solo, the accompaniment is minimal before everything returns soon after. Strong track.Track 6 - Where in the World (3:45)This one fades in with a faster tempo pattern. I like the guitar countermelody over the rhythmic soundscape. The vocals begin with minimal keyboard accompaniment; it reminds me of Asia's "Wildest Dreams". Of course, Mitchell is in the current version of Geoff Downes' Asia (not to be confused with John Payne's Asia), but not as lead vocalist but as the guitarist, but his vocal tone and style would fill that niche nicely. The chorus has a lot of forward momentum. The song cuts loose even more in the bridge at around 2:30. Another masterful guitar solo follows. Awesome track!Track 7 - Twin Suns (6:22)This is the longest track on the album. An ominous drone starts us off, soon joined by a cool rhythm pattern. The vocals come in at around 40 seconds. The verses are in 6-4 and I believe we are in 5-4 during the choruses, if I am counting correctly. A short guitar solo happens between the first chorus and second verse. A longer guitar solo follows after the second chorus. I love the refrain of "Twin suns in the distance" as the song fades out. Cool song!Track 8 - The River (5:55)A short, but strong intro quickly gives way to the first verse, which is accompanied by acoustic guitar strumming and electric piano. The rhythm section kicks in at around one minute in, following the first verse. I like Blundell's drum patterns on this song (and throughout the album, for that matter). The acoustic sections give me Pink Floyd vibes. The guitar solo comes in at around 4 minutes. A bridge follows. I like the overall arrangement of this song. The song closes with the line "on and on, the river's just begun". Good one.Track 9 - Rearview (4:39)This one starts directly after "The River". Some synth tones give way to a "tribal" type of drum beat, The band joins onto his foundation. Nice key change going into the chorus. I love the production on this album. The melodies here are complex and take some unexpected turns. Awesome drum fill from Blundell as the guitar solo concludes at around 3:55. An intriguing song that will probably require repeated listenings to fully digest. Track 10 - Bending Light (5:37)An unusual, distorted synth tone plays arpeggios and Mitchell enters on vocals with a drum machine rhythm. Blundell gives a real drum and cymbal accent a couple of times. Mitchell's voice sounds anguished. A spoken part is low in the mix, discussing relationships. This is another one that will take multiple listens to fully digest, lyrically, but I am drawn in. Blundell joins in fully at around 3 minutes. The guitar solo begins at around 3:45. His playing and his voice are very expressive. Sound effects and the drum machine pattern close it out. Haunting track. Track 11 - The Iron Sea (3:50)Ocean shore sounds fittingly start us off here. Sound effects give an uneasy effect. Michell's voice reminds me more of Peter Gabriel here. The music builds up and explodes at around 2 minutes with power chords. This one reminds me a little of "Space-Dye Vest" from Dream Theater, at least in its vibe. That is a favorite DT song of mine, so consider that a compliment.Track 12 - Oblique (3:23) A simple but slightly disturbing piano pattern in 6-8 stars off the final proper album song. Mitchell's vocals are bittersweet here, especially as he sings "Sorry, my heart breaks gently". I believe we are saying goodbye to the "Lonely Robot"...I'm not crying?you're crying"...Track 13 - Synthetic (Vinyl only Bonus Track) (3:22)A sustained synth chord starts us off then John joins in on vocals. There are subtle drums. This is another bittersweet song, with a haunting, yet hopeful vibe. Mostly keys and vocals.OVERALL IMPRESSIONS:A wonderful close to John Mitchell's Lonely Robot series of albums. There is a reason that John is so in demand as a guitarist as well as vocalist. While there are lots of synths and electronic sounds, his guitar and vocal parts bring a sense of warmth and humanity. Blundell's drumming adds a great sense of dimension to the sound as well. I really enjoyed that. There is a lot of depth in the lyrics that will take me some time to fully wrap my mind around, as I am a music first, lyrics later kind of guy. But it is a very strong album that fans of Pink Floyd/David Gilmour and prog/mainstream rock hybrids will truly enjoy. I give it 4.5 out of 5 stars (90%).

items._cn_summary: 这是爱尔兰吉他手John Mitchell以Lonely Robot名义发表的系列最终专辑，由他本人包办人声、吉他、贝斯与键盘，鼓手Craig Blundell与客座吉他手Jez Fielder协作完成。整体风格延续跨界前卫摇滚路线：键盘铺底配合强劲节奏，奇数拍变化穿插其中，旋律偏八十年代AOR质感，人声被类比为John Wetton或Greg Lake。评论者特别提到首曲以合成器节奏与人声和声作为苦乐交织的开场，第二首在能量爆发中插入清唱收尾，第三首则以中速行进鼓点与丰富混响营造空间感。专辑定位偏向旋律化、可听性较强的前卫摇滚，未涉及用户偏好的实验、自由即兴、电子或暗潮元素。

items.body: Anyx Starlink A streak of hope threads through the sombre tones of this arresting solo debut by the former Anchoress singer Starlink by ANYX When Anna Lucia Nissen titled her debut album as Anyx Starlink, she knew it would elicit some reactive grimacing. Inspired by mistaking the branded satellites for stars, the title comes with the complicated associations of genuinely useful infrastructure whose use enriches a horrible man. But this friction suits her solo project well. Throughout Starlink, Nissen works to balance conflicts between harsh and soft tones, defiant and optimistic themes, and organic and manufactured sources. Anyx as a project feels like a more individual continuation of Nissen’s work as part of Anchoress. Starlink was written with her former bandmates, but the musical and... items._cn_summary: Anyx是前Anchoress主唱Anna Lucia Nissen的个人项目，《Starlink》是其首张专辑。专辑名源自她将星链卫星误认为星星的灵感，承载着有用基础设施与邪恶资本之间的复杂联想。整体音乐在冷峻与柔和、对抗与乐观、有机与人工之间寻求平衡，继续了Nissen在Anchoress时期的工作线索，并由前乐队成员参与创作。编曲概念围绕对立元素的张力展开，风格延续了此前乐队的艺术摇滚底色，并融入电子质感的声音设计。评论来自The Quietus，内容篇幅较短，未深入展开具体的音色与结构分析，但对专辑核心矛盾的概念框架有清晰阐述。整体定位更偏向独立艺术摇滚与暗黑氛围之间的中间地带，虽具艺术思考但实验性与先锋程度有限。

items.body: GAMI, a trio from Marseille, released the single Anymore on 28 August 2026 through B-Side Prod, together with a lyrics video on the band’s own channel. It is the first track pulled from Underneath, their debut album, which follows on 23 October 2026 on the same label. The band play a rock built on trip-hop foundations, and the new single moves that further towards guitar and synth. UNDERNEATH by GAMI What GAMI put on ‘Anymore’ Rémi Bernard composed the track and Capucine Trotobas wrote the words. Rémi Gettliffe mixed and mastered it at Whitebat recorders. Trotobas sings and plays bass, Bernard plays guitar, and David Benzazon plays drums; the pair of instrumentalists share the arrangement credits across the band’s catalogue. Trotobas described the subject of the song in a statement supplied with the release: “The idea behind this song is finding yourself alone beneath the surface, face-to-face with your own thoughts. It’s the feeling of being caught in a spiral of situations that might spin out of control. It’s an internal struggle, constantly telling yourself, ‘Stop, we don’t go back there! Watch out: DANGER.’ Because there is no desire to let your own demons catch up and overwhelm you. But in the end, can we really control it all?” “Underneath” runs to eleven tracks: “Underneath”, “Face It”, “Anymore”, “Glass”, “Masking”, “Fragment”, “Move On”, “Pills”, “Settle”, “To Be Hears” and “Sweet Pea”. The album is on pre-order through Bandcamp; “Anymore” is also on the streaming platforms. About GAMI GAMI work out of Marseille as a three-piece: Capucine Trotobas on composition, vocals and bass, Rémi Bernard on guitar and arrangement, and David Benzazon on drums and arrangement. All three trained at conservatoires in the region, Trotobas in Aix-en-Provence and Nîmes, Bernard at the Cité de la Musique de Marseille and SATIS at Aix-Marseille Université, and Benzazon in Aix-en-Provence. The band describe their own sound as a pop-rock shaped by trip-hop, and name Radiohead, Portishead and Jeff Buckley among their reference points. Two of the three have other bands in the same city. Bernard fronts the psychedelic rock group Avee Mana, formed in 2018, on vocals and guitar. Benzazon drums in 1003, a Marseille act that mixes industrial and electronic textures into pop. The recorded history starts with “Make A Path”, a six-track cassette released on Ganache Records on 27 October 2021 and later reissued digitally. The “Step by Step” EP followed on 17 November 2023, carrying “Step by Step (Moon)”, “Kid Memorial”, “Great Sorrow”, “Wasting” and “Sun Above The Clouds”, with its title track and “Kid Memorial” issued as singles that autumn. The band then put out “Broken Leg Unplugged” on 14 February 2025. “Anymore” is the first new GAMI release since, and the first from an album rather than an EP.
items._cn_summary: GAMI是来自马赛的三人乐队，成员均在当地音乐学院受训，风格定位为trip-hop基底上的流行摇滚，融合吉他与合成器层次。首张专辑《Underneath》共收录十一首曲目，单曲《Anymore》已先行发布。其创作主题围绕内心挣扎与自我审视，歌词探讨表面之下的孤立感与思绪失控的漩涡。乐队将录音作品描述为受Radiohead、Portishead和Jeff Buckley影响的产物，但整体仍属独立流行摇滚范畴，制作由Whitebat录音室完成，在独立厂牌B-Side Prod发行。乐评以新闻稿形式呈现，侧重信息罗列而非深度音乐分析。

items.body: Scheitan, the gothic rock band from Luleå in northern Sweden, released a lyric video for Queen of The Lions on 28 August 2026. The band describe the track as a dark and gloomy goth ballad, and it reaches the major streaming platforms on Friday 4 September. It is the first taste of a new, as yet untitled album that the band say will follow in 2027 through The Circle Music. Queen of The Lions by Scheitan Who made ‘Queen of The Lions’ The song runs 3:50. Pierre Törnkvist wrote the lyrics, and the music is credited jointly to Törnkvist and Swedish producer Daniel Bergstrand, who also mixed the track at his Dugout Studio in Uppsala. Bergstrand’s engineering and production credits take in In Flames, Meshuggah, Soilwork, Dimmu Borgir, At The Gates and Behemoth, and he is not new to this band: he mixed Scheitan’s 2024 album “Songs For The Gothic People”. The single artwork is by ErlikWindsteel. The band play the Hellsinki Industrial Festival in Finland on 19 November 2026. The eighth edition of the festival runs from 19 to 21 November, with the opening night at On The Rocks in central Helsinki and the two following nights at Tiivistämö. Scheitan share that first bill with Agent Side Grinder and Stuka; Gothminister and Extize are among the acts on the later nights. About Scheitan Scheitan formed in Luleå, in Norrbotten in northern Sweden, in 1996, around Pierre Törnkvist and Oskar Karlsson. The band’s first three albums ran through a fast stylistic arc, from black metal into a rougher rock idiom: “Travelling in Ancient Times” appeared in 1996 on the German label Invasion Records, “Berzerk 2000” followed on the same label in 1998, and “Nemesis” came out on Century Media in 1999. All three were recorded in Luleå with engineer Göran Norman. The band then stopped. Törnkvist kept working. He plays in Helltrain, which he started with Karlsson and his younger brother Patrik Törnkvist, and in Devil’s Force. Karlsson died in 2016. Scheitan restarted in 2021 with the “Deathgoth” EP, and returned in earnest in 2023 with three singles, “Lost in Time”, “Fire at Dawn” and a cover of Billy Idol’s “White Wedding”, all pointing at gothic rock rather than the band’s 1990s output. The Greek label The Circle Music has released the two albums since. “Songs For The Gothic People” came out on 22 May 2024, preceded by the single “Believe” in January that year, and was recorded in Luleå and mixed by Bergstrand. “Wine For a Tormented Soul” followed on 19 December 2025 with eight tracks written by Törnkvist, trailed by the singles “Carry Me Home” and “Heaven Tonight”. Törnkvist discussed the band’s second run in a 2024 Side-Line interview. “Queen of The Lions” is the first release since the standalone single “A Million Days” earlier in 2026, and the first from the album planned for 2027.
items._cn_summary: 本文为 Side-Line 发布的纯新闻稿，介绍瑞典哥德摇滚乐队 Scheitan 发布新单曲《Queen of The Lions》的歌词视频，曲目时长三分五十秒，由乐队主脑 Pierre Törnkvist 撰写歌词，与瑞典制作人 Daniel Bergstrand 合作谱曲并在其 Dugout Studio 完成混音，后者曾参与 In Flames、Meshuggah、Soilwork、At The Gates 等金属乐队制作。文章追溯了乐队自 1996 年在吕勒奥成立以来的演变历程，从早期黑金属到近年转向哥德摇滚，提及两张近作《Songs For The Gothic People》与《Wine For a Tormented Soul》均由希腊独立厂牌 The Circle Music 发行，并预告 2027 年新专辑及年底芬兰工业音乐节的演出安排。整体属于信息类报道，缺乏对音乐本体或艺术价值的评论分析。

items.body: A Certain Ratio have released two companion albums on the same day. The Joy of Sextet and Force Majeure both arrived on Mute on 28 August 2026 on limited coloured vinyl, CD and digital, marking 45 years since the Manchester group recorded “Sextet” and 40 years since the release of “Force”. Two extra UK tour dates have been added to the October run that goes with them. The Joy of Sextet by A Certain Ratio Two different answers to two anniversaries “Sextet” was recorded at Revolution Studios in Cheadle Hulme, Stockport, in 1981 and released on Factory Records in 1982, the first A Certain Ratio album the band produced themselves. It spent 11 weeks in the UK Independent Chart and reached number one. The line-up on it was Donald Johnson, Jez Kerr, Martin Moscrop, Peter Terrell, Simon Topping and Martha “Tilly” Tilson, who the band had met in New York while recording “To Each…”. Kerr has said Tilson’s lyrics “reflect her take on life in Manchester, ‘walk along the waterline, see the ships passing by, grey skies, still water'”. “The Joy of Sextet” is a new nine-track mix of that record, built by Andy Meecham of The Emperor Machine from the original 1981 two-inch multitrack tapes at Vertical Lab. It keeps six songs from the 1982 album, drops “Skipscada”, “Rub Down” and “Rialto”, and adds “Tumba Rumba”, a “Waterline” dub and a 12-inch version of “Knife Slits Water”. The running order is “Lucinda”, “Crystal” in a night version, “Gum”, “Knife Slits Water”, “Tumba Rumba”, “Day One”, “Below the Canal”, the “Waterline” dub and the “Knife Slits Water” 12-inch version, each carrying an EM credit. Meecham described the work as a return to the desk: “Taking on an epic album like this involved pushing up the faders again from the original 1981 2-inch multitracks adding some new dynamics while recapturing the sound of 1981 without losing the original raw energy and feel. The talent, innovation and sheer musicality blew me away every day I worked on this. A labour of love, one I would undertake again in a heartbeat.” Side-Line covered two of the singles from it, the “Knife Slits Water” mix in July and “Tumba Rumba” in August, after the two albums were announced in May. Meecham had already reworked “Constant Curve” for the band in 2023. Two further tracks, “Gum” and “Take Me Down”, went up as official audio streams on release day. Force Majeure by A Certain Ratio “Force Majeure” works the other way round. Rather than remixing the 1986 album, it compiles nine earlier versions of songs from that period, produced by the band with Stuart “Jammer” James, who died in Manchester in July 2015. James had recorded the material on four-track as working demos and later handed the tapes back to the group. Moscrop explained how they resurfaced: “Stuart helped us record the tracks to review the songs for a possible album, to work on arrangements and practice playing them live. Listening to the recordings many years later I was surprised at how good they sounded, so we decided to share them with everyone for this Force companion album”. The album runs “Only Together”, “Bootsy”, “Naked and White”, “And Then She Smiles”, “Take Me Down”, “Anthem”, “The Runner”, “Force” and “Nostromo a Go Go”. Two of those, the title track “Force” and “The Runner”, were not on the 1986 record. That album, recorded and mixed at Yellow 2 Studios in Stockport in July and August 1986, was produced by James with the band and featured Kerr, Moscrop, Johnson, Andy Connell and Anthony Quigley alongside Tom Barnish and Corrine Drewery. “The Joy of Sextet” is out on “The Joy of Curacao” coloured vinyl, CD and digital; “Force Majeure” is out on “Unforced Purple” coloured vinyl, CD and digital. Both are sold through Bandcamp and the band’s own store. A Certain Ratio tour dates 2026 The anniversary tour plays both albums in full, in two sets with an interval and no support act. Three shows are sold out, and two dates have been added since the tour was announced: a second Manchester night on 25 October and a Nottingham show on 1 November. The band said of the run: “We’re celebrating these two milestones with this tour, to say we are very excited is an understatement. It will be a real challenge, which we’ve already started preparing for, with nine months to go! We will be playing two sets with no support.” 07.10.2026 – Birmingham, UK – Castle & Falcon 08.10.2026 – Bristol, UK – Exchange 09.10.2026 – London, UK – Dingwalls 10.10.2026 – Lewes, UK – Con Club (sold out) 13.10.2026 – Newcastle, UK – The Cluny 14.10.2026 – Edinburgh, UK – The Voodoo Rooms 15.10.2026 – Glasgow, UK – Òran Mór 16.10.2026 – Blackpool, UK – Bootleg Social 17.10.2026 – Leeds, UK – Brudenell Social Club 22.10.2026 – Hebden Bridge, UK – Trades Club (sold out) 23.10.2026 – Stoke, UK – The Sugarmill 24.10.2026 – Manchester, UK – Band on the Wall (sold out) 25.10.2026 – Manchester, UK – Band on the Wall (added) 01.11.2026 – Nottingham, UK – JT Soarfest About A Certain Ratio A Certain Ratio formed in Greater Manchester in 1977 around Peter Terrell on guitar, Simon Topping on vocals and trumpet, Jez Kerr on bass and vocals, Martin Moscrop on trumpet and guitar and Donald Johnson on drums, with Martha Tilson joining soon after. They were among the first acts on Tony Wilson’s Factory Records, debuting in 1979 with “All Night Party”, produced by Martin Hannett, and mixing post-punk with funk, disco and Latin percussion at a point when few of their peers did. Seven top-ten UK independent releases followed during the Factory years, among them “Flight” and “Waterline”. The studio albums ran from “The Graveyard and the Ballroom” in 1980 through “To Each…” in 1981, “Sextet” in 1982, “I’d Like to See You Again” later that year and “Force” in November 1986. Spells with A&M Records and Rob Gretton’s Robs Records came at the end of the 1980s and into the 1990s, after which the band worked intermittently until “Mind Made Up” in 2008. The current phase runs through Mute, which reissues the back catalogue and has released the recent studio records: “ACR Loco” in September 2020, the “A”, “C” and “R” EPs in 2021, “1982” in 2023 and “It All Comes Down to This” in 2024. The band’s Factory history sits alongside New Order and Happy Mondays in the label’s story, and Side-Line has covered the group’s Mute-era work since Andy Meecham’s “Constant Curve” rework in 2023. The line-up on the current tour is Jez Kerr, Donald Johnson, Martin Moscrop and Martha “Tilly” Tilson, who spend October playing “Sextet” and “Force” end to end.
items._cn_summary: 本文介绍A Certain Ratio同日发行的两张纪念专辑。《The Joy of Sextet》是为纪念1981年录制、1982年首发的同名专辑45周年，由The Emperor Machine的Andy Meecham从原始两英寸多轨磁带重新混音而成的九曲版本，保留六首原曲并新增包括'Tumba Rumba'和'Waterline' dub在内的三首作品，重新编排曲目顺序并加入电子混音处理。《Force Majeure》则是为纪念1986年专辑40周年，以反向逻辑编纂九首当年歌曲的早期版本，与已故制作人Stuart James合作录音。发行采用限量彩色黑胶、CD和数字格式，配以十月英国巡演。作为Factory Records出身的曼彻斯特乐队，其后朋克与放克融合风格具有实验色彩，但本文以新闻资讯为主，缺乏深度乐评内容。

items.body: Bradford post-punk band 1919 release the two-track single “Last Dance of the Departed” on 13 November 2026, backed with “Satellite Man”. It is the group’s first 7-inch since the “Cry Wolf” single of 1983 and their first studio release since 2021. Pre-orders run through Bandcamp in four formats: a black 7-inch, a limited green 7-inch pressed in an edition of 300, a CD single, and a digital download at 24-bit/96kHz. Physical copies ship on or around the release date. The single carries a Cry Wolf/Engineer Records credit. 1919 line-up and recording credits Simon “Ding” Archer recorded both tracks at 6db Studios in Salford. He plays bass and handles programming in the current line-up, alongside Rio Goldhammer on vocals, Sam Evans on guitar and founding drummer Mick Reed. Goldhammer wrote the lyrics and produced the sleeve design. Goldhammer also directed the video for “Last Dance of the Departed”, posted to the band’s YouTube channel on 21 August 2026. It cuts together live and archive footage contributed by more than a dozen photographers, DJs and promoters, each credited by name. The B-side title is not new to the catalogue. 1919 self-released a digital EP called “Satellite Man” on 24 December 2021, which was until now their most recent studio material. About 1919 1919 formed in Bradford, England, in 1980 around guitarist Mark Tighe and vocalist Ian Tilleard, who had started out as Heaven Seventeen before taking the name 1919 from a book in Tighe’s collection. Bassist Nick Hiles and drummer Mick Reed completed the first settled line-up. Reed described the intent as “to create a heavy melodic intense dance band with no frills and no intentions”. The band issued “Repulsion” / “Tear Down These Walls” as a white-label 7-inch promo in 1982, then re-released it through Red Rhino Records, which also carried the “Caged” single and the mini-album “Machine” in March 1983. They recorded a first John Peel session in May 1982 and a second on 4 May 1983. Steve Madden replaced Hiles that year. Abstract Records issued the “Cry Wolf” 7-inch and 12-inch in 1983 and the “Earth Song” 12-inch in July 1984, after the group had already split. Kev Aston on saxophone and Paul “Sputnik” Drake on synthesizer appeared with the band at various points. Members went on to 1919 AD, The Hive and Another Cinema, all of which had ended by 1986. Tighe restarted the band in 2014 with bassist and vocalist Rio Goldhammer, self-releasing the download “Revenge” in 2015. Reed returned on drums on 30 August 2015 and Karl Donner joined on bass, moving Goldhammer to vocals. Westworld Recordings released the album “Bloodline” on 3 March 2017. Tighe died on 28 January 2017 at the age of 56, after a cancer diagnosis the previous year, and the band published an obituary in four languages; Side-Line reported it in British post-punk legends 1919 announce death guitar player Mark Tighe. Sam Evans joined as full-time guitarist in April 2017. Steve Madden died shortly before “Futurecide” appeared on Cleopatra Records on 12 April 2019; the album carries Tighe’s last recorded performance, on “Stop the World”, and Madden’s, on “Isolation”. Side-Line ran the first play of that album and its video in Side-Line exclusive: UK post-punk band 1919 premieres new video and album!. Archer, previously a bassist and producer with The Fall, PJ Harvey and Red Lorry Yellow Lorry, replaced Donner on 31 August 2020. The Paris label Manic Depression released the album “Citizens of Nowhere” on 25 June 2021, and the self-released “Satellite Man” EP followed that December. The band made their US debut in Los Angeles in 2023 after a Wave-Gotik-Treffen appearance in Leipzig. “Last Dance of the Departed” is their first new studio recording since 2021.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非传统乐评，而是英国布拉德福德后朋克乐队1919发布双曲单曲的新闻稿，介绍其新作《Last Dance of the Departed》及其B面《Satellite Man》的发行信息，包括黑胶与CD等四种格式的预购方式。文中详细列出乐队当前阵容与录制班底，并追溯乐队自1980年成立以来的历史沿革，涵盖早期成员变动、厂牌合作（Red Rhino、Abstract Records）以及2014年重组后由新厂牌Westworld Recordings发行专辑《Bloodline》等关键节点。原文未涉及任何对音乐风格、制作手法或艺术价值的评论，因此仅作为资讯类文本供读者了解乐队动态之用。

items._cn_summary: 该内容并非传统意义上的专辑乐评，而是一份旧金山湾区实验音乐演出的周历清单，来源为Bay Improviser及多个本地场地资讯汇总。文中提及的演出包括Ark of Bones、Darren Johnston、Jordan Glenn与Ben Goldberg等即兴音乐人，活动场地涵盖Medicine for Nightmares、The Lab、SFJAZZ、Center for New Music等本地实验与即兴音乐重镇。虽然演出信息涉及自由爵士与即兴演奏，但内容仅是日期、地点与艺术家姓名的罗列，缺乏对音乐本身的描述、风格分析或听觉体验的讨论。由于没有任何评论性文字或音乐细节，信息量极为有限，不足以构成一份有效的乐评或推荐文本。

items.body: It's been a while since we've visited with one of my favorite "microscenes" - the French stoner and doom metal scene. Luckily, one of my favorite bands from that area of the world are back with a new album this year and have graciously afforded me the privilege of premiering a single from said album. I covered Pelegrin for the first time four years ago with another premiere and I've been waiting for more music since then. Happily, "Sun and Blood" does not disappoint with a trippy, occult-steeped video and, more importantly, a more muscular and present approach to Pelegrin's sound than before. Head on down below to take the journey!Pelegrin's previous music can be described as "airy", a certain thinness which worked very well with the expansive can of psychedelia they were going for. But here, the adjective would be "earthy" - the main riff is much more present in the mix, its tone thicker and heavier. The drums are punctual like falling stones, lending the track momentum and groove. Sprinkle in the same excellent vocals from the previous release, one scorching, desert-sun hot solo, and a few more touches here and there from excellent backing riffs and thick bass, and you've got yourself a treat. I also love the lighter guitars which open the track, setting the ground for the shimmering, stoner sound the band is so good for."Sun and Blood" comes to us from the upcoming The Curse of Nephtar, due to release on September 4th on the mighty Ripple Music. You can head on over here to pre-order it (and also check out that glorious art work in full).
items._genre: stoner metal / doom metal / psychedelic rock
items._cn_summary: 法国乐队Pelegrin时隔四年带来新单曲《Sun and Blood》，出自即将发行的专辑《The Curse of Nephtar》。乐评指出，与以往空灵、稀薄的迷幻气质不同，这首作品明显转向更扎实、更沉重的方向：主riff在混音中占据更突出的位置，音色更厚更重；鼓点如落石般干脆，赋予节奏推动力。人声延续了前作的水准，另有一段炙热的沙漠烈日式独奏，以及厚重的贝斯和辅助riff作为细节铺垫。开场的轻吉他音色营造出闪烁的迷幻氛围，为整体声音奠定基调。作品由独立厂牌Ripple Music发行，艺术视觉带有神秘学色彩。整体而言，这是一首在原有风格基础上强化力量感的迷幻厄运金属作品。

items.body: Review by Prog Dog — [Fave Tracks: Charlie Knew, Legend of Mary Jo]My four-word review: Excellent, and damn fun.Anyone familiar with Phideaux Xavier will probably find this review interesting, because I'm a total newbie to his music. So don't get mad at me.I more or less ignored prog rock for 30 years after being an early appreciator of the genre. And while Phideaux's Automoto Animus isn't an overtly progressive-rock album, and doesn't profess to be, there's no missing the prog influence. ProgArchives even categorizes it as crossover prog, and I can hear why.Right off the bat, what appealed to me about the album is how much it feels rooted in the '70s and especially the '80s. I'm hearing touches of Meat Loaf, Queen, David Bowie, Elton John, ELO, even Billy Idol on the opener track'not necessarily in a direct, 'this sounds exactly like X' kind of way, but in its sense of melody, theatricality, and musical personality. I was even reminded of The Lamb Lies Down On Broadway/Genesis during the 14 minute finale 'The Legend of Mary Jo'.Automoto Animus is a super likeable album. I'm usually less interested in lyrics and more drawn to melody and instrumental execution, but I've been finding the words here equally irresistible. Phideaux has a focused way of addressing the listener that reminds me of David Bowie and, at times, Peter Gabriel. There's something very direct and intentional about the way he delivers these songs.The music isn't exactly lightweight, but it has a breezy playfulness to it, and there's a sharpness of wit behind the songwriting. This is intelligent pop with lots of musical twists and personality that keeps my prog ears perked.What fascinates me most about the album is the way each song feels like a monolith of songwriting and production. There's an almost impenetrable quality to the way these tracks are constructed. Every song feels fully formed, with a palpable sense of self-confident soulfulness, as if every possible weakness has already been identified and eliminated.That's a strange thing to say about an album, but it's one of the things I find most attractive and remarkable about Automoto Animus. Nothing feels tentative. The arrangements, melodies, production choices and performances all seem to know exactly where they're going. The songs don't so much unfold as stand there, fully realized.Instrumentally speaking, there's an abundance of really interesting guitar work and tones throughout the album. The keyboards and piano also play a big role overall, but it all strikes a nice balance. The drums are, for the most part, relatively straightforward, but soulful and anchoring. And then there's the saxophone. I'm a bit particular about sax'I love the way Bowie, Duran Duran and David Sylvian/Japan have used it, but it can easily go the other way for me. Thankfully, it's all good here. So despite how pressure-tested and rock-solid everything feels on this album, it remains fun and inviting without ever becoming overly self-serious. It's good to know people are still making adventurous, genuinely enjoyable albums with prog-rock leanings. There's plenty of ambition here, but it never gets in the way of the fun. I give Automoto Animus a 4.5 out of 5 dog bones rating, or rounded out to 4/5 for the esteemed progarchives.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张定位为交叉前卫摇滚的作品，但评论者明确指出它并不自称为纯粹的前卫摇滚。专辑融入了七十年代末至八十年代的大量流行摇滚元素，提及Meat Loaf、Queen、David Bowie、Elton John、ELO等经典艺人的影响。评论者认为歌曲编排成熟且自信，每首歌都感觉完整且经过精心打磨，歌词直接有力，旋律感强。器乐方面，吉他音色丰富多变，键盘与钢琴占据重要地位，鼓点简洁但有灵魂，萨克斯的运用恰到好处。十四分钟的终曲让人联想到Genesis的《The Lamb Lies Down on Broadway》。整张专辑呈现出一种机智、轻松且具戏剧性的气质，属于带有前卫摇滚根基的智能流行作品。

Like in the previousR�colte, Guy Richer & Francine Hamelin participate again to much of the songwriting, but this is atthe expense of the group members, IMHO.Opening unexpectedly on the banjo jig piece Global Refus, the middle section has a certain Fairportfeel. A violin and a cello grace J'Avais Oubli�. Richer's Proclamation announces the French folkstandard V'l� Le Bon Vent and the ren,dition is somewhat what you'd expect from Malicorne or LaBamboche. But we're waiting for the 7-mins+ Galadriel piece and indeed, it's the album's bestmoment, where the music developments and arrangements approach the symphonic movements. Le Silence opens the flipside, but the string arrangements drown out the song's heart. Allison is aforay into medieval folk, armed with Gilles Vignault's texts and it is a highlight of the album, butthe "rock" side is not part of it. A little later, L'Homme Du Nord is another piece that mixes folkand progressives arrangements and at times one can think of Harmonium's l'Heptade. The closingCrepuscule has Marie-Claire improvising vocals over a great instrumental background. In a way,Cr�puscule is the ideal closure to the S�guin adventure.At the height of their popularity, the S�guin twins chose to part ways, to pursue their own solocareers, which would both involve their Harmonium buddies. Though Richard's collaboration withFiori is well-known, Marie-Claire's first two albums are filled with Harmonium alumni. Festin is astar-studded affair, but allow me to prefer their first two more intimate creation, because they hadmore poignant moments. Over the course of their four albums, one can compile of excellentprogressive tracks that would make it an essential compilation of Quebec orog.

items._cn_summary: 这张1976年的专辑由Séguin这对双胞胎兄妹领衔，融合了魁北克法语民谣与渐进摇滚元素。专辑邀请了多位知名乐手参与创作与录制，小提琴、班卓琴、大提琴等乐器交织出浓郁的民俗色彩。最为突出的七分钟长曲Galadriel展现出向交响化发展的编曲野心，将民谣基底推向更接近Harmonium《l'Heptade》的渐进摇滚方向。Marie-Claire的人声即兴段落作为终曲收束全作。整张专辑虽有明星阵容加持，但评论者认为其过于依赖外部词曲合作，反而削弱了团体自身的创作力度，与前两张相比少了更亲密动人的时刻。作为CBC（应为CBS）主流厂牌发行，专辑在商业上达到了Séguin的巅峰时期，但乐评人更倾向其早期更内敛的创作。

items.body: Review by Bovver — Fragile opens with the epic Roundabout the album largely maintains that extremely high level quality progressive rock across throughout. In fact there really is only a single blemish on this masterpiece (and even that is a personal dislike for me) - the inclusion of Wakeman's interpretation of a little Brahms that provides us with the second track on the album. Thankfully the blot on the landscape is a mere minute and a half long and so this entirely forgettable inclusion does not destroy the album but it really does ruin the effect produced by Roundabout and then picked up again by the rest of the tracks. There are many highlights across Fragile, from Squire's punchy base, to Anderson's beautiful vocal harmonies and the complex compositions that combine these extraordinarily talented individuals efforts into a masterpiece of music that is almost without equal.Even Wakeman, despite providing the lowlight of the album, impresses with his abilities to control a range of instruments in support of the band's sonic creations and I guess Fragile represents the pinnacle of Yes' output, alongside Close To The Edge. My personal preferences guide me more toward those more melodic efforts such as Relayer and Going For The One but even I can see that the true value of Yes to progressive music lies in those groundbreaking efforts that include Fragile. Few bands can match Yes for talent and for compositional originality at this stage of their career and most don't even come close. The album itself develops nicely from the punchy opener through Wakeman's embarrassment towards the powerful South Side of the Sky which is a personal highlight as it seems to marry the individual contributions more impressively than the other tracks.The album contains plenty of awkward sounds and sudden transitions, paying absolutely no respect to traditional musical structures, representing dreamland for diehard progressive music fans; and, by the way, becoming extremely popular amongst the general public at time of release - something that could only have happened during those enlightened years of the 70s. There is a lot going on at different levels but if you want to just sit back and mellow then Anderson's vocals will give you everything you need with their beautifully expressive lyrical melodies. I am tempted to remove track 2 from the album to experience it without that jolt but frankly I have too much respect for this entire band to do that. it would perhaps be sacrilegious?As expected, when you have top quality talent, really expressing themselves then you really need top quality production and that is exactly what we get. I really wouldn't change a thing. I guess the shorter track times make this effort a little more accessible to the masses despite the rampant progressive changes and occasional quirkiness mixed in with classical influences (including Spanish guitar sounds) but I once again have to say that I prefer the extended tracks of Close to Edge, Relayer, Going for the One etc... Having said that, if you need a gentle way in to "classic" Yes then you could not do better than Fragile as it provides you with a complete context for Yes' work without burying you in something that you aren't ready for. This is certainly one of the best progressive rock albums of all time and for me is only overshadowed by a very small number of other works.
items._cn_summary: Yes乐队1971年专辑《Fragile》是交响前卫摇滚的代表作，以史诗曲目开场，融合古典与摇滚元素。专辑包含复杂的作曲结构、丰富的人声和声以及频繁的节奏与情绪转换，展示了乐队成员的高超技巧。评论者特别赞赏Squires的贝斯表现和Anderson的声线，但对Wakeman演奏的Brahms改编古典片段持保留意见，认为打断了专辑整体的连贯性。制作精良，曲目时长相对较短使作品更具亲和力。整体而言，这是一张展现70年代前卫摇滚黄金时期水准的作品，但评论者个人更偏爱乐队其他更具旋律性的专辑。

items.body: Review by Sean Trane — S�guin's second album's artwork (still released on the major Warner Bros label) may take a wink to LNF's Hymne Aux Quenouilles, but I don't see much a musical link. Anyway, the band returns with the same line-up, but also get reinforcements by a slew of guests, but it's not like they bring a new dimension.The A-side consist of 6 relatively-short tracks that are in the standard folk-rock mode (too gentle for my tastes), though some of the arrangements can be quite pleasant, especially the closing Nous Voyagerons, which luckily happens to be the longer track, by a margin. The flipside starts in the same gentle folk-rock, however a violin enters Chante, Danse and bring a much-more exciting and exotic (almost dronal/medieval) ambiance/arrangements. The same magic ambiance is transposed (albeit differently) into the Mois de Mai. But We're now facing an 8-mins closer, named F�te du Feu, opening on deep horns & crickets, but it develops to an Amerindian chant (something we'd suspected with their first album's G�nocide track) over bagpipes and steady martial drums then 100% native chants, the whole thing being quite dramatic (though not as strong as G�nocide) the two merging together, before the final crickets return. If En Attendant can be considered as a bit of a disappointment to progheads, but for folkheads, it's got everything to please them. Thankfully, the best three tracks are the album's longest and it ends much better than it started.

items._cn_summary: 这是Séguin乐队的第二张专辑，整体以标准民谣摇滚为基调。A面六首短曲偏向温和的民谣摇滚风格，编曲虽偶有亮点但缺乏足够深度。B面引入小提琴后音色转向更具异域色彩的中世纪风格氛围，后段的《Fête du Feu》以深沉号角与蟋蟀声开场，发展为美洲原住民吟唱，融合风笛与军鼓，戏剧性较强但整体震撼力不及首张专辑的《Génocide》。专辑在民谣基础上尝试融入原住民音乐元素与世界音乐色彩，但A面过于平淡，作为前卫作品对前卫乐迷略显失望，更适合民谣爱好者。专辑由华纳兄弟发行，属于主流厂牌商业发行。

items.body: Review by Sean Trane — A much more focused album than their very naive debut, though you'll still find the hippie idealism found on LNF. And this is because Quenouilles (survival plants water reeds) was recorded soon after their first effort, so you'll find traces of everything. Graced with a lovely gatefold artwork, l'Hymne is a much better affair, despite opening on a Ballade des Bourgeois not exactly announcing things to come. A slow organ looms and cowbells of Transition is taking things to the upper level , though not that satisfyingly so, because the instruments jam clumsily. Citoyens Du Monde shows the usual hippie idealism and Si Loin has Marie Claire singing solo over a an electric piano. On the flipside, Confiture Bleue (Blue Jam/jelly) is a bit too derivative of another song that it lacks a bit of credibility, though its bluesy dimension is quite enjoyable around the end of the track. The almost 7-mins Indifference starts slowly but develops in a very interesting (adventurous) middle section . But the real highlight of the album is the 7.5-mins title track that should blow some minds out with its slow organ crescendo and driving drums .Much like their debut , Quenouilles is still flawed, but the peaks are really enjoyable. Again a bit schizophrenic , torn between folk (mainly the A)side) and psych rock(the flipside), Quenouilles is out to stretch your mind, but doesn't necessarily succeed because of their overt naivet�. I will round out the album to the upper forth star, because of the intent, even if not entirely successful.
items._cn_summary: 这张1970年法国前卫民谣专辑相比处女作更加聚焦，但依然保留着嬉皮理想主义色彩。整体在民谣与迷幻摇滚之间摇摆不定，呈现出某种分裂感。A面以民谣为主，B面则偏向迷幻摇滚。开场曲平淡无奇，Transition中风琴与牛铃的出现试图提升层次但器乐配合略显笨拙。Marie Claire在Si Loin中以电钢琴伴奏的独唱较为突出。Confiture Bleue的蓝调维度在后段展现得不错但整体略显衍生。七分钟左右的Indifference中段发展出有趣的冒险性，而同名曲L'Hymne Aux Quenouilles是专辑真正的高光——缓慢的风琴渐强与强劲的鼓点交织。作为1970年法国小厂牌发行的早期前卫民谣作品，意图明确但因过于天真的表达未能完全成功，仍属可圈可点的小众尝试。

items.body: Review by Sean Trane — A very naive d�but album, , not helped by Quebec's local music industry mostly snubbing LNF and dismissing them as hippies (which the band was back then), there is a real peace & love feel to their music on this progressive folk album. The band consisted of the twins S�guin (both singing), organ player Th�roux and guitarist Letendre. Their gentle folk rock opens the album with the lovely Pacification and follows with the cheesy Temps de Mar�e, despite a rockier ambiance. Heros is more of a traditional folk piece and is followed by the short and aerial Sans L�gende where Marie-Claire soars over a calm bed of guitars. A cover of fellow Montrealer L�onard Cohen's So Long Marianne, which I personally could've done without (not a Cohen fan, though it's fairly different feel (happy as opposed to sad) from the original. The flipside opens with a traditional-like folk and it could be the title track, but lacks the "Nouvelle" side. Le Chemin Du Roi is certainly more of a rockier affair with psyched-out fuzz guitar and underlying organ, but again the naive feel can be smothering a bit the original aim. Things get slightly embarrassing with Aimer de t'Aimer, best skipped to the liturgical Alleluia, which really shows the musicians' hippieism. But this countered by the instrumental very Funky Monkey with typical psych-garage feel, which makes you scream for more. This debut album is a bit schizophrenic, torn by the twins' folk aspirations and the two soloists who crave to rock harder. In the meantime, this is hardly essential, but if you want to listen to their much better follow-up, you'll have to "suffer" (you'll survive ;-)p)))) this one because the only way to find it is through the 2-on-1 CD compilation with an ugly cover.

items._cn_summary: 这是魁北克乐队La Nouvelle Frontière的1970年首张专辑，定位为前卫民谣。乐队由Séguin双胞胎兄妹、Théroux风琴手和Letendre吉他手组成，作品弥漫着嬉皮士式的和平与爱气息。专辑前半部分以柔和的民谣摇滚为主，Pacification开场温柔，Sans Légende中Marie-Claire的声线在吉他铺垫上飞翔，还翻唱了蒙特利尔同乡Léonard Cohen的So Long Marianne。唱片后半段风格出现分裂，双胞胎偏向传统民谣，而两位独奏乐手则渴望更摇滚化的表达，Le Chemin Du Roi的迷幻模糊吉他风琴与Funky Monkey的迷幻车库器乐都体现了这一点。整体来看，专辑存在内在矛盾，音乐理念不够成熟，且评论者明确表示这张并非必听之作，仅作为通往他们更优秀后续作品的过渡。

items.body: The UK-based Nigerian producer stretches and pulls the sonics of sacred spaces into mind-bending new shapes Ibukun Sunday on 25.10.2025 at Daylight Music at St John’s Leytonstone [credit Kat Ciemiega Photography] Every year the Semibreve Festival takes attendees on a side quest through the churches of Braga. Each day brings at least one performance of deep, reverberating music in one of the Portuguese city’s many historic places of worship. It’s impossible not to notice the idiosyncratic reverbs these buildings house, but just as integral to how we listen is the hush and awe they induce. I’m not religious. My main reason for visiting a church is to experience concerts of droney, ethereal experimental music. But prolonged exposure to these kinds of places... The post Sounds of Praise: Olúsín [Worshippers] by Ibukun Sunday appeared first on The Quietus.
items._cn_summary: Ibukun Sunday 是一位居住在英国的尼日利亚制作人，这张专辑将神圣空间的声学特质拉伸塑造成全新的听觉形态。文章以葡萄牙布拉加 Semibreve 音乐节为背景，描述了在历史教堂中聆听 droney、ethereal 实验音乐的体验。评论强调了教堂特有的混响与静默氛围对听觉感知的塑造作用，指出这些场所独特的声学环境是不可或缺的聆听要素。专辑名称 Olúsín 在约鲁巴语中意为「崇拜者」，暗示其创作概念与宗教空间之间的深层联系。文章篇幅较短，更多是节选性质，未深入分析具体的制作手法或声音设计细节，信息密度有限。

items.body: And Also The Trees play eleven shows in the UK, the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany between 20 September and 5 October 2026, in support of the UK post-punk group’s album “The Devil’s Door”, released on 27 February 2026 through the band’s own AATT imprint. The run opens at the Castle And Falcon in Birmingham and closes at Nachtleben in Frankfurt, with seven of the eleven dates in Germany. Tickets are listed on the band’s official site. The autumn dates follow three July appearances as special guests of The Cure at the Festival de Nîmes in France, and a spring run through Belgium, France and Greece that Side-Line covered when the album was detailed in January. “The Devil’s Door” carries eleven songs and completes a trilogy recorded by the group’s current five-piece line-up, following “The Bone Carver” (2022) and “Mother-of-pearl Moon” (2024). The band mix orchestral guitar lines, soundtrack-style arrangements and dark jazz rhythms, drawing on newsreel footage, oil paintings and British and European folklore. Belgian violinist Catherine Graindorge guests on the record, alongside Colin Ozanne’s clarinet. The band’s press material describes the album as “a quiet storm of a record that is by turns filmic, poetic and intense, with an undercurrent of dark psychedelia”. It is available on LP, CD and digital. The opening track and lead single, “The Silver Key”, was issued with a video directed by Sébastien Fait Divers and shot at night along the Thames near Westminster Bridge. The devil’s door by And Also The Trees And Also The Trees autumn 2026 tour dates 20 September 2026 – Birmingham (UK) – Castle And Falcon 24 September 2026 – Nijmegen (NL) – Doornroosje, Paarse Zaal 25 September 2026 – Brussels (BE) – Le Botanique 26 September 2026 – Liège (BE) – Reflektor 27 September 2026 – Oberhausen (DE) – Kulttempel, with special guest Catherine Graindorge 28 September 2026 – Hannover (DE) – Lux 30 September 2026 – Detmold (DE) – Stadthalle Detmold 1 October 2026 – Berlin (DE) – Bi Nuu, with special guest Catherine Graindorge 3 October 2026 – Coesfeld (DE) – Fabrik 4 October 2026 – Hamburg (DE) – Logo 5 October 2026 – Frankfurt (DE) – Nachtleben The touring line-up is Simon Huw Jones (vocals), Justin Jones (guitar), Paul Hill (drums), Grant Gordon (bass) and Colin Ozanne (clarinet and other instruments). Catherine Graindorge, who plays violin on the album, joins the band as special guest at the Oberhausen and Berlin shows. About And Also The Trees And Also The Trees formed in 1979 in the village of Inkberrow, Worcestershire, England, around brothers Simon Huw Jones (vocals, lyrics) and Justin Jones (guitar), with Graham Havas on bass and Nicholas Havas on drums. Early demos reached The Cure, who took the group on tour in 1980, 1981 and 1984. Robert Smith produced the self-released mini-album “From Under The Hill”, and Lol Tolhurst produced the 1983 debut album “And Also The Trees”. “Virus Meadow” (1986) paired dense guitar arrangements with pastoral and pagan lyrics, and was followed by “The Millpond Years” (1988), “Farewell To The Shade” (1989) and “Green Is The Sea” (1992). “The Klaxon” (1993), “Angelfish” (1996) and “Silver Soul” (1998) moved toward a more urban, 1950s-inflected palette of twanging guitars, brass and organ. After a quieter stretch the band returned with “Further From The Truth” (2003), “(Listen For) The Rag And Bone Man” (2007) and the acoustic reworkings collection “When The Rains Come” (2009). “Hunter Not The Hunted” (2012) took them to Ukraine, Romania, Lithuania and Japan, and back to The Cure’s stage for three nights at London’s Hammersmith Apollo in 2014. Paul Hill joined on drums in 1997; Grant Gordon and Colin Ozanne complete the current five-piece. The thirteenth album “Born Into The Waves” arrived in 2016, after which the band moved to self-releasing through their AATT imprint with “The Bone Carver” (9 September 2022) and “Mother-of-pearl Moon” (23 February 2024). The documentary “Slow Pulse Boys: The Story of And Also The Trees” appeared in 2024, and the group featured on “Resurgence“, the 7CD post-punk boxset issued by Alfa Matrix in January 2025. They have released sixteen studio albums. Touring has stayed continuous across that stretch, from the Swiss and Italian dates of 2025 through the March 2026 shows in Belgium, France and Greece; the autumn run is their second European leg behind “The Devil’s Door”.
items._cn_summary: 该文章为一篇纯新闻稿，报道英国后朋克乐队And Also The Trees的秋季巡演日期及相关专辑信息。文章介绍其新专辑收录十一首歌曲，是当前五人阵容三部曲的终章，前两部分别为2022年和2024年发行。作品融合管弦乐吉他线条、电影配乐式编曲及暗黑爵士律动，融入英国与欧洲民间传说元素。比利时小提琴家及单簧管演奏者在专辑中担任客串。文本几乎不含实质性乐评内容，未对音乐质感、创作手法或艺术成就做出任何深度评价，仅为信息性发布，缺乏评论价值。
